profiles.name: map-idle-relief.cpuprofile
profiles.treatment: unchanged; no WASM nodes occur in this idle profile

limits: Each captured profile covers roughly 8.15-8.24 seconds, separate from the paired throughput measurement window.
Self and inclusive times are accumulated sample weights; they are not method invocation counts, direct CPU-cycle measurements, or GPU time.
Inclusive rows overlap through ancestry and must not be added.
Unresolved native/runtime/generic-extra samples remain anonymous; no name inference was applied.
Only candidate profiles were symbolicated here; these data do not establish a regression cause or baseline-versus-candidate difference.
Individual methods with few leaf samples have weak precision; the reported leaf sample counts are retained.
